newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: S&P assigns BBB to Fletcher Challenge notes.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns BBB to Fletcher Challenge notes.

text.p: Credit ratings agency Standard and Poor's said on Monday it had assigned its BBB rating to both tranches of a US$350 million global note offering by Fletcher Challenge Capital Canada Inc (FCCC).
FCCC is issuing $200 million 7.5 percent notes, maturing March 24, 2007, and US$150 million 7.875 percent notes, maturing March 24, 2017.
S&P said the rating reflected that of the issues' guarantors, Fletcher Challenge Ltd and Fletcher Challenge Industries Ltd.

"Fletcher Challenge's competitive cost position in each of its core operation (sic), its geographic and business diversity, and moderately conservative financial position should ensure stable credit quality in the medium term," S&P said.
New Zealand's Fletcher Challenge is an Auckland-based company that operates in four core industries: paper, energy, building and solid wood plantation forestry.
